court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sumit S/O Maheshchandra Upadhyay vs Master Arnav S/O Sumit Upadhyay Thr. His ...
facts_of_case: Father and mother entered into consent terms under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Permanent alimony for the respondent child has been taken care off as a one-time settlement.

legal_principles.principle: The consent terms filed before the learned Family Court and registered as Petition No.F-782 of 2021 shall be fructified by being converted into a decree of divorce by mutual consent.
legal_principles.held: He further submits that the consent terms have been filed before the learned Family Court and have been registered as Petition No.F-782 of 2021 and after the expiry of the statutory period, shall be fructified, by being converted into decree of divorce by mutual consent

legal_principles.principle: Proceedings under section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 should be decided before disposing of other proceedings.
legal_principles.held: Mr. Bhishikar, learned counsel for respondent does not dispute the above position and submits that the matter be kept in abeyance till such time the proceedings under section 13-B of the said act are being decided

outcome.final_order: Proceedings to be disposed of in terms of the decree passed in Petition No. F-782 of 2021

use_for_drafting: representing clients in family court proceedings
